# Acme Warehouse design system

Scope: primary group. Accepted. Use the existing visual language.

## Colors
- Ink: #203040
- Paper: #f4f7fa
- Accent: #285c98
- Surface: #ffffff

## Typography
System sans-serif; body 16 px / 1.5; headings 24 px / 1.25. Labels remain visible.

## Spacing
4, 8, 16, 24, 32 px. Controls use 8 px radius. Primary actions use accent and white text.

## Behavior
Visible focus, native controls, associated field errors, complete empty and success states. Preserve Acme components before adding new treatments.
